elements.name: Sled chassis and rollers
elements.note: One sled serves all twelve cells. No redundant sled, no manual release. Review item 22

elements.name: Stator winding
elements.note: Segmented per paper.tex Sec.VII, so losing one segment degrades rather than stops. NOT credited below -- segmentation is stated, never analysed

elements.name: Power converter (SiC bridge)
elements.note: No radiation or SEE qualification path exists. Review item 25

elements.name: Energy store (bank or flywheel)
elements.note: P26: the bank cannot source the shot on purchasable parts. A25's flywheel adds a rotating mechanism

elements.name: Position sensing / commutation
elements.note: A synchronous machine that loses position feedback cannot commutate

elements.name: Eddy brake
elements.note: PROVISIONAL: pole plates lightened on structural reasoning alone, no magnetic sizing. P28. Failure may also eject the sled -- review item 23

elements.name: Launch lock release
elements.note: One-shot, fires once. The only shared element that does not cycle

elements.name: Retention gate (2 x D9 pins)
elements.note: A22 resized D6 -> D9 for the vibration case. Cycle life untested
